Shuyuan Shen is an Assistant Professor of Political Science and International Relations at Loyola Marymount University. He received his Ph.D. in Political Science from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. His research sits at the intersection of comparative politics and international relations, with a focus on Chinese domestic and global politics, comparative political communication, and political economy. His work has been published in International Studies Quarterly and World Development.

title: Research
text:
Research


Information, authoritarian politics, and China in the world
My work examines how political actors use information to persuade, distract, and govern—and how those strategies shape public opinion at home and international relations abroad. I combine computational approaches with experiments and comparative analysis.
